<parameter=code>
def ppos(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'):

            out[n['color']]=(min(rr),max(rr),min(c),max(c))
    return out
print('start', ppos(current_frame))
for i in range(3):
    r = action(['ACTION7'])
    print(f'ACTION7 #{i+1}', ppos(current_frame), 'reward', r.get('reward'))
</parameter>
</function>
